prompt_messages.content: You are the Dialogue-only Adaptive controller. Use only the visible dialogue: no graph nodes, edges, relation types, graph novelty, or graph-derived interpretations. Decide what is still missing or ambiguous. Generate exactly three indirect candidate questions and select one, or Stop only when the dialogue already supports all four persona dimensions. Never expose candidate labels. Return JSON only; do not provide chain-of-thought.

Completed turns: 1/5
Dialogue:
Q1: What do you typically do on a regular day?
A1: I usually start my day reviewing the progress on current projects, ensuring everything aligns with the established roadmap and that we’re meeting our key performance indicators, often spending a good portion of the day focused on analyzing data and adjusting strategies based on what I’ve observed during my trips – it’s fascinating to see how different markets respond to similar approaches.

Return exactly this schema:
{
  "action": "Explore or Stop",
  "target_dimension": "social_role, personality, background, interests, or null",
  "candidates": [
    {"question": "...", "coverage_gain": 0.0, "redundancy_penalty": 0.0}
  ],
  "selected_question": "... or empty for Stop",
  "rationale_summary": "one short evidence-based phrase"
}
